metadata.note: Command teardown of the ./setup script itself — the free-by-default readiness checker at the toolkit root. Bash 3.2-compatible (macOS-safe), built around a check() helper that eval-writes dynamic OK_<id>/MISS_<id> vars instead of declare -A. Two verbs: bare './setup' (verify + FEATURE table + exit 0 iff all green) and './setup --install' (pip install requirements.txt + npm install runtime/remotion + copy bundled fonts + curl Kokoro model files from thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx releases — then verify). Readiness is decided ONLY by live verification — importing every Python dep, actually running ffmpeg/ffprobe, and synthesizing + decoding one real Kokoro phrase whose mean_volume must exceed -40 dB. Thirteen atomic checks aggregate into 7 FEATUREs; any missing atomic hint prints under the blocked feature. Unique-to-setup content vs the sibling doctor episode: the pip contract from requirements.txt (numpy>=2.0.2 pinning story), the four-phase --install pipeline, and the ElevenLabs guard at setup:102-115 (a paid-provider quarantine — the script exits 1 the day any of four fingerprints reappears in a file that isn't setup itself). All demo output in demo/RUN-LOG.txt is verbatim from this workstation, section 3 captured with runtime/models temporarily unlinked to force one red row. No paid API, no upload, no network calls beyond the setup smoke test's local Kokoro synth. Playlist adaptation for @HumanitariansAI: composer folder chip reads @HumanitariansAI; outro card is the locked ClaudeTitleOutro with hardcoded @NikBearBrown handle per OUTRO-LOCK.md — flagged in README.md for the human reviewer before publication. episode.source_sha256 cf8873d1a540147a49b11feff3dd4ab774fd4f0e0ef9941c52895bd691bb628c. Source changes in this build: (1) setup --install pipeline refactored from || chaining to if/! blocks with explicit b/r output headers; (2) setup success output now includes ./art keys and ./art smoke advice lines; (3) requirements.txt added commented-out optional playwright section. B04 narration updated to highlight the art smoke proof line; B05 code block updated to current source.

beats.narration_text: Watch the writer walk this back. Setup does not install everything by default. It verifies, live — imports every Python module, runs ffmpeg, and makes Kokoro actually speak. Only if you add dash dash install does it fetch anything. A green row is a spoken proof, not a receipt from a package manager.

beats.role_note: FALSIFIABILITY — unlink runtime/models; audio row goes red with two hint lines; exit 1. Recovery: restore, or --install re-fetches. Verbatim from demo/RUN-LOG.txt sections 3 and 4.
beats.narration_text: One failure worth showing. Unlink the Kokoro model directory — the models are the one thing not in the git repo, because they're three hundred megabytes. Re-run setup. Audio row goes red. Two hint lines print underneath: the model files are missing, and the synth-and-decode phrase failed. Every other row stays green. Exit code: one. Recovery: put the files back — or on a fresh install, run setup with dash dash install and the fourth phase of the pipeline downloads them for you. The exit code is the whole point — a red row never ships a build.

beats.role_note: VERDICT — the whole surface, in the order you use it.
beats.narration_text: So — setup. A live-verification readiness checker, with an optional install-first mode. Two modes, one script, one seven-row table. It reads requirements dot txt for the pip contract, it makes Kokoro speak for the audio row, it refuses to run if a paid provider is smuggled in, and it exits zero only when every atomic check passes live. Run this before you fill a beat sheet, and downstream failures with cryptic messages become failures with a checklist.

props.artifactHeading: setup — the whole surface, in the order you use it
artifactLines: two modes — ./setup verifies; ./setup --install installs pip + npm + fonts + Kokoro model, THEN verifies.
one pip contract — requirements.txt: kokoro-onnx, mutagen, Pillow, numpy>=2.0.2, manim, faster-whisper. Six lines. One pinned floor.
live verification only — imports every Python dep, runs ffmpeg, makes Kokoro speak a test phrase above -40 dB. Receipts don't count.
13 atomic checks → 7 features — any missing atomic check blocks the whole feature and prints its fix line beneath.
ElevenLabs guard — greps for four fingerprints before any check runs; exits 1 the moment any file outside setup itself matches.
exit 0 all-green; exit 1 any-red — run this before a beat sheet, so downstream failures come with a checklist, not a mystery.
